recommendation: Keep the FHIR core audit as-is. If authoritative IMGT/HLA registration information needs work now, raise or apply that in the HL7 Terminology/TSMG source of truth rather than restoring the old external row in the FHIR core Code Systems page.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive vocab change request for the STU3 terminology Code Systems page to change the external IMGT/HLA row's OID to 2.16.840.1.113883.6.341 and remove the trailing slash from the URI, yielding http://www.ebi.ac.uk/ipd/imgt/hla.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 0a95e00e03c30ab8aa2a1adea453b74bd5cc0968, matching the Jira comment's SVN revision 12790, changed source/terminologies-systems.html from http://www.ebi.ac.uk/ipd/imgt/hla/ and OID 2.16.840.1.113883.13.252 to http://www.ebi.ac.uk/ipd/imgt/hla and OID 2.16.840.1.113883.6.341.
additional_context: FHIR-37853 later established HL7 Terminology as the source of truth for external code and identifier system information and removed external rows without FHIR-specific usage documentation from the core Code Systems page. The current build-scoped source/terminologies-systems.html points readers to terminology.hl7.org/external_code_systems.html for authoritative external URI/OID information, and no current core source row contains the old IMGT/HLA URI or OID.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding or editing the old IMGT/HLA row in FHIR core would conflict with the later THO source-of-truth decision, and the stale row is not present in current core source.
